def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None, variation=None):
    return CartPosition(
        event=event, item=item, variation=variation, price=23, used_membership=membership,
        expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), cart_id="123",
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_passes_without_membership_requirement(event, customer, granting_ticket):
    validate_memberships_in_order(None, [_cart_position(event, granting_ticket)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_missing_membership(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_missing_customer(event, membership, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_rejects_membership_of_other_customer(event, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(other, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message

def test_validate_memberships_rejects_membership_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):

    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_uses_variation_membership_types(event, customer, membership, membership_type,
                                                               requiring_ticket):
    variation_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Variation pass")
    variation = requiring_ticket.variations.create(value="VIP", require_membership=True)
    variation.require_membership_types.add(variation_type)

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, variation)], event)
    assert 'membership' in excinfo.value.message

    variation_membership = customer.memberships.create(
        membership_type=variation_type,
        date_start=datetime(2021, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ),
        date_end=datetime(2021, 4, 30, 23, 59, 59, 999999, tzinfo=TZ),
    )
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, variation_membership, variation)],
                                  event)

    membership_type.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_respects_ignored_order(event, customer, membership, membership_type,
                                                                 requiring_ticket):
    membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership_type.save()
    q = event.quotas.create(size=None, name="foo")
    q.items.add(requiring_ticket)
    order = _create_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', positions=[
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership),
    ], now_dt=now(),
                          sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
                          payment_requests=[{
                              "id": "test0",
                              "provider": "banktransfer",
                              "max_value": None,
                              "min_value": None,
                              "multi_use_supported": False,
                              "info_data": {},
                              "pprov": BankTransfer(event),
                              "payment_amount": Decimal("23.00"),
                          }],
                          locale='de', customer=customer)[0]

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)

    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                  ignored_order=order)
